name: notebooklm
tagline_zh: 网页版藏着的功能，这里全开。说一句“做个播客”，自动建笔记本、加源、生成音频，还能导出多种格式。
tagline_en: Unlock hidden NotebookLM powers. Say 'make a podcast'—it builds notebooks, adds sources, generates audio, exports.
desc_en: Complete API for Google NotebookLM - full programmatic access including features not in the web UI. Create notebooks, add sources, generate all artifact types, download in multiple formats. Activates on explicit /notebooklm or intent like "create a podcast about X"
why_zh: 同类工具只做表面，它直连底层API，连网页端没有的功能都能调，真正的一站式自动化。
why_en: Unlike wrappers, it taps the raw API—exposes features missing from the UI, giving true end-to-end automation.
